entries.카오스폰즈의 핵심 전투 요소 — 카드 속성, 등급, 키워드, 더미 규칙,: A reference page for Chaospons' core combat elements — card suits, rarities, keywords, pile rules, and positions.
entries.전투 시작 시 8장 드로우: Draw 8 cards at the start of combat
entries.캐릭터 수 × 2장 (유물·버프에 의해 변동 가능): Characters × 2 cards (can change via relics and buffs)
entries.6 (유물·버프·상태 이상에 의해 증감 가능): 6 (can change via relics, buffs, and status effects)
entries.20장 (초과 시 버린 카드로 이동): 20 cards (excess goes to the discard pile)
entries.버린 카드 더미 전체를 덱으로 이동 후 셔플 → 남은 수 드로우: Shuffle the entire discard pile into the deck → draw the remaining cards
entries.남은 AP는 다음 턴으로 이월되지 않음 (기본 규칙): Unspent AP does not carry over to the next turn (base rule)
entries.모든 적 HP 0 이하 → 보상 획득 → 탐사 지속: All enemies at 0 HP or less → collect rewards → continue exploring
entries.모든 아군 HP 0 이하 → 탐사 실패: All allies at 0 HP or less → expedition fails
entries.도주 카드/스킬 사용 시 즉시 종료, 승리 보상 미지급: Using an escape card/skill ends combat immediately; no victory rewards
During combat, every card is in one of four piles: deck, hand, discard, or exile.
entries.현재 가지고 있는 모든 카드. 매 턴마다 손으로 (캐릭터 수 × 2)장을: All the cards you currently own. Each turn you draw (characters × 2) cards into your hand. When the deck hits 0, the whole discard pile is shuffled back into it and you draw the rest.
entries.현재 턴에 사용 가능한 카드. 카드 사용 시 효과 처리 후 버린 카드 또: Cards playable this turn. A played card resolves its effect, then goes to the discard or exile pile. Cards left in hand at end of turn are handled by the rules.
entries.이번 전투에서 사용하거나 턴 종료 시 버려진 카드. 덱이 소진되면 전부: Cards played this combat or discarded at end of turn. When the deck runs out, they all return to the deck and are reused.
entries.현재 전투에서 제외된 카드. 제외된 카드는 현재 전투에서 다시 사용할 수: Cards removed from the current combat. Exiled cards can't be used again this combat. Cards with the Exile, Ethereal, or single-use keywords go to this pile.
entries.각 카드는 4가지 속성 중 하나를 가지며, 동일 속성 카드를 조합하면 강: Each card belongs to one of four suits, and combining cards of the same suit creates powerful synergies.
entries.단일/광역 피해, 방어력 감소 등 물리 계열 효과 중심. 적의 체력을 직: Focused on physical effects such as single-target/AoE damage and defense reduction. Specialized in cutting down enemy HP directly, with strong synergy with Attack-position characters.
entries.마법 피해, 저항력 감소, 상태이상 부여 등 마법 계열 효과 중심. 물리: Focused on magic effects such as magic damage, resistance reduction, and status ailments. Effective against enemies with high physical resistance, and they combine with a variety of debuffs for layered strategies.
entries.체력 회복, 강화(버프), 디버프 제거 등 지원 효과 중심. 지원 포지션: Focused on support effects such as healing, buffs, and debuff removal. Paired with Support-position characters, they greatly boost the whole party's survivability.
entries.드로우, 행동력(AP) 회복·증가, 코스트 조정 등 운영 효과 중심. 전: Focused on tempo effects such as draw, AP recovery and gain, and cost adjustment. The core suit of Strategy-position characters, maximizing deck cycling and turn efficiency.
Basic cards. Low cost and simple effects. The backbone of your deck.
Stronger effects or extra side effects. Sharpens your deck's direction.
Strategic cards with conditional triggers or combined effects. The heart of a build.
Powerful unique effects. Includes some character-exclusive cards. Lowest drop rate.
Card keywords define special conditions, persistence, and effect triggers.
entries.전투 중 카드의 동작 규칙을 결정하며, 일부는 유물 또는 상태 이상과 연: They set how cards behave in combat, and some interact with relics or status effects.
Stays in your hand instead of being discarded at end of turn.
entries.카드를 사용하거나, 턴 종료 시 손에 남아 있으면 자동으로 제외(Exil: Automatically exiled when played or if still in your hand at end of turn.
※ Mutually exclusive with Retain. Cannot apply both.
entries.카드를 사용하거나 버려질 경우 버린 카드(Discard)로 가지 않고 제: When played or discarded, goes to the exile pile instead of the discard pile.
Always in your hand on the first turn of a stage.
When played, choose one of the effects listed on the card to trigger.
※ Resolves in order: Scout (reveal deck) → Choose (pick effect) → Decisive (bonus).
entries.직접 사용할 수 없으며, 턴 종료 시 손패 처리 규칙에 따라 버려지거나: Can't be played directly; at end of turn it's discarded or exiled according to hand rules.
Temporarily adds 1 copy of this card to your hand for this combat.
entries.해당 카드로 대상을 처치 시 효과가 발동된다. 처치 판정은 \"마지막으로: Triggers when this card kills its target. The kill goes to "whoever last brought HP to 0 or below."
Spends all remaining AP and applies the effect X times, where X is the AP spent.
※ If X = 0, the effect is also 0.
entries.덱 상단에서 X장 카드를 확인 후 원하는 카드를 선택하여 손으로 가져온다: Look at the top X cards of your deck and put the one you want into your hand.
Triggers a bonus effect if this card was drawn via Scout.
When played, automatically targets a random living unit on the field.
※ With no valid target, it's discarded/exiled with no effect.
Lets you target any enemy regardless of Taunt.
entries.각 캐릭터는 포지션을 가지며 카드 속성·스탯 성장·전투 행동 패턴에 영향: Every character has a position, which shapes their card suits, stat growth, and combat behavior.
A position that deals heavy damage to enemies.
entries.검과 마법을 통해 단시간에 적을 제압하지만, 방어나 회복 능력이 부족해: Overwhelms enemies quickly with blades and magic, but lacks defense and healing, so it needs support from other positions. Quick decisions and attack timing are key.
A position that takes damage in place of allies.
entries.높은 체력과 방어력을 바탕으로 도발과 보호 스킬을 사용해 팀의 생존을 책: Backed by high HP and defense, it uses taunt and protection skills to keep the team alive. Essential for a stable run.
A position that aids allies with healing, buffs, and debuff removal.
entries.공격력은 낮지만 팀 전체의 유지력과 안정성을 크게 높이며, 적의 위협을: Low attack, but greatly boosts the team's sustain and stability, reduces enemy threats, and turns the tide of battle.
A position that controls the flow of battle and specializes in creating openings.
entries.카드 드로우, 코스트 조절, 적의 행동 교란 등으로 전장을 지배하며 효율: Dominates the battlefield with card draw, cost control, and enemy disruption, enabling efficient turns.

entries.\"정신력 기반 카드 변화 + 각성/붕괴 전투 스타일 전환 + 서사 연계: "Sanity-driven card shifts + Awakening/Collapse combat styles + story-linked play"
entries.정신력 상태에 따라 카드의 성능·효과·활용 방식이 변화한다. 카드를 뽑고: Your cards' power, effects, and uses change with Sanity. It's not just drawing and playing cards — it's a dual-layered tactic of also managing your characters' inner state.
entries.각성 / 붕괴로 인한 전투 스타일 전환: Combat Styles Shift via Awakening / Collapse
entries.정신력 변화는 단순 디버프가 아니라 각성과 붕괴라는 극단적 상태 변화로: Shifting Sanity isn't just a debuff: it leads to the extreme states of Awakening and Collapse, which overturn your whole combat style. Will you keep the crisis in check, or push it to the limit?
entries.캐릭터 감정선, 기록 수집, 호감도, 세계관 단서가 전투와 탐사 보상에: Character arcs, collected records, affinity, and lore clues tie into combat and exploration rewards, so playing itself becomes the way you unlock the story.
entries.무겁고 침잠된 세계관 위에 개성 강한 캐릭터 서사와 감정선을 결합. 하드: A heavy, brooding world paired with character stories and emotional arcs full of personality. It delivers a hard-edged atmosphere and deep character immersion at once.
One day, an unidentified substance of alien origin began to be detected all over the world.
entries.기존 과학 기술로는 분석·측정·예측이 불가능하며 강력한 에너지로 주변 환: It defies analysis, measurement, and prediction by existing science, and its powerful energy eats away at its surroundings.
An unidentified substance of alien origin that triggered the collapse of the world.

entries.각 구역은 고유한 환경 기믹, 정신력 변동 방식, 등장 몬스터, 보상 테: Each zone has its own environmental gimmicks, Sanity mechanics, monsters, and reward tables.

entries.외계 기원의 오염성 광석. 접촉 대상의 물질 구조를 파괴가 아닌 다른 규: Contaminating ore of alien origin. It has the property of Conversion — not destroying the material structure of what it touches, but rewriting it under different rules. Forms black/blue-gray crystals.
entries.네크레이트 에너지 노출 시 물질·생명·지형이 서서히 변화하는 현상. 암세: A phenomenon in which matter, life, and terrain slowly change when exposed to Necraite energy. It spreads on its own like cancer, signaled by purple/black galaxy-like patterns.
entries.0~100 범위 수치. 기본값 50. 100에서 각성(Awakening): A value from 0 to 100, starting at 50. At 100, Awakening triggers for 3 turns; at 0, Collapse triggers for 3 turns. Afterward it resets to 50. Allies and monsters follow the same rules.
entries.복원자(Restoration Unit) 중 최강의 정예 22인. 세룰리온: The 22 strongest elites of the Restoration Unit. Based on the Ceruleon, they explore the Encroached Zones and carry out purification operations. Named from the Latin 'arcana' (secrets).
entries.침식지대 진입·변성체 감지·정화 작전 수행이 가능한 초장거리 함선형 탐사: An ultra-long-range, ship-like exploration vessel able to enter Encroached Zones, detect transmuted beings, and run purification operations. Base of the 22 Arcana. Upgrade its facilities for meta progression.
entries.네크레이트를 가져온 외계 기원 고등 생물. 인간이 이해 불가능한 구조의: Advanced lifeforms of alien origin that brought Necraite. Beings with structures beyond human comprehension. Approaching them deals critical Sanity damage. They control aberrations or create new mutations.
entries.정체불명 외계 물질 네크레이트가 감지되며 세계 붕괴가 시작됨. 현 과학: The unidentified alien substance Necraite is detected, and the collapse of the world begins. Current science cannot analyze, measure, or predict it. Living things fall into a chain of infection → mutation → aberration.
entries.침식지대 내부 진입→오염 확산 차단→침식핵 파괴를 목표로 한 반복적 공세: Repeated offensives aimed at entering the Encroached Zones → stopping the spread of contamination → destroying Erosion Cores. Not a single victory, but an ongoing war.
entries.침식 확산으로부터 인류 생존권을 지키는 최후의 방어 구획. 거대한 방벽과: The last line of defense protecting humanity's living space from the Encroachment. Sealed off from the outside by massive walls and Gates. The starting point of every purification operation.
entries.퇴색 근원과 밀접한 최고 난이도 탐사 구역. 매 노드 이동 시 정신력 -: The hardest exploration zone, tied closely to the source of the Fading. Sanity -1 for every node moved. A desaturated world drained of color. Unlocks after meeting the Ending C conditions.
entries.침식지대 내부에서 오염 확산을 유지하는 핵심 구조물. 정화 작전의 최종: The core structure that sustains the spread of contamination inside an Encroached Zone. The final objective of purification operations; destroying it brings down that area's Encroachment anchor.
entries.탐사 중 발견하는 수집형 스토리 아이템. 세계관의 진실과 아르카나의 과거: Collectible story items found while exploring. They hold the truth of the world and the Arcana's past, and count toward the Ending C condition (80%+ collected).
